nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Banana Bright Vitamin CC Sticks for Dark Circles

avis.texte: This is sn expensive product and the entire tube broke off on the cap on day one. Bad delivery system. I have pictures abd wanted to share them in the review hut there is no way to attach them through this phone app

I have tried lots of concealers and under eye serums in the past, but I have found a winner. It gives just enough cover and light reflects beautifully from the under eye area. It goes on smooth and doesn't cake. It is a bit pricey, but lasts.

Product itself is moisturizing and works well as skincare first eye primer with minor color correcting. Helps my powder concealer look great. Did notice brightening over time. Wouldnt buy it again though because it was superfluous. Am eye cream will moistuize just as well and if i wamt coverage i use an actual color corrector.

I first got this product in an ipsy glam bag, and it was the first item I have actually repurchased after trying. I have naturally dark undereyes, and this helps reduce the look of them alone and even more with concealer over top. It does not fully take away the dark circles, but mine are pretty blue/purple, and its not as thick as a traditional color corrector would be! But overall does a great job!
Good product but the packaging is horrible. the stick completely broke and got stuck in the cap. Pls fix!! for the price they should come up with a better storage solution

avis.titre: Hands Down the BEST for Dark Circles!!!!
avis.texte: First, let me say I rarely leave reviews. But you guys need to know just how wonderful of a product this is! Shape Tape who??? I had no problem with blending in and I LOVED the instant coverage!

avis.titre: Great as a brightening, priming eye cream
avis.texte: I've used an entire stick and buying another. I have genetic dark circles, hollow eyes, and baggy eyelids that are dry to normal skin type. I use this stick in the daytime under makeup or alone on no-makeup days, and it works effectively as a brightening eye cream and eye primer. However the coverage is not significant enough for me to consider this "color correcting" and I still need to use a color corrector concealer. Maybe if your dark circles are less severe, this could color correct for you. But to me, this is a skincare product, not a makeup product. Also, I havent noticed a difference in brightness after longterm use. It definitely moisturizes and brightens the eyelid without being greasy, and effectively primes for makeup. I will be buying another.
Poor coverage, and cakey look. Had to take it off and throw away

Great color corrector that provides a great base for concealer. It is hydrating which is perfect for my dry skin! I'm a very fair olive and guava was perfect. It's more sheer than a purely makeup color corrector so just something to think about if you want/need a more pigmented product. When blended in on its own the skincare aspect makes it look very natural.

I always use a color corrector and picked this one up on sale awhile ago. I am very fair and Guava is DARK. The formula is fine, nothing special but it doesn't crease and feels nice on the skin. The issue is the color. There's no way this is correcting fair complexions; it's more accurate to label Guava as "light" instead of "fair".

avis.titre: Poor coverage and difficult to layer or blend
avis.texte: I wanted to love this because of the color and convenient packaging, but it's a miss for me. I have combination skin, so I tried this layered over moisturized that had set in and without moisturizer. In both scenarios, the product barely gave any coverage and needed to be layered. However, when trying to layer or blend, the product balled up and rubbed off.

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again.
avis.texte: This concealer works very well to cover the black circles under my eyes. If I use no other makeup on a day, I always use this.

avis.titre: Waste of money and worse than concealer
avis.texte: I have very bad dark circles and I hoped this product would be help cover them up, whether alone or under my concealer. Before I could try it more than a few times, the entire stick flew out when I opened it and landed in my bathroom sink. I was not aggresive in uncapping it - it was a product flaw. I replaced it and used it for a month or two before the same thing happened again - this despite my being overly careful after my first experience. That being said, even without the design flaw, it is a bad product. On its own, its coverage and color correcting were weaker than my concealer. Layered under my concealer it looked horrible - greasy and weirdly pale and washed out. My concealer in its own (Nars Radiant Creamy Concealer) looks much better, both color and texture wise.
Very heavy and thick consistency. I have this in the yellow and much smoother. Had to return unfortunately.
I love any product that I use from Olehenriksen!! His products all work great! This product helps hide your dark circles and is moisturizing.

avis.titre: I only got to use it once.
avis.texte: I really like the utility of this product. Guava is a great color corrector for super pale people like myself, and it covered my under eye circles well. When i tried to put powder over it, the product moved a lot and got patchy. I had read other reviews that it breaks easily so made sure to barely roll it up and roll it all the way back down before i put the cap on. It fell off my counter on to a pile of towels, so not even a hard floor, and now the entire stick is stuck inside the cap. I will be returning it if i can.

I'm over 60 and this definitely helped my under eye area. It smoothed out my textured skin and seemed to give a tighter look. I just added a little concealer and powder after applying the Banana Bright stick. I highly recommend this for aging eyes.

avis.titre: Pills under eyes no matter what I try
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this and I have tried to use it at least a dozen times with different eye creams and even no eye cream and no matter what I do, it pills under the eyes and sinks into fine lines I didn't even know I had. It doesn't matter how much or little I use. I finally give up. I would definitely NOT recommend.
I expected more from this considering the reviews were so good but maybe they were paid actors lol… This does nothing really.

I was able to use the product for a couple of weeks before the entire stick flew out as I was opening it. So for those couple of weeks, it was an easy concealer to quickly put on in the mornings for those days I was not wearing full makeup. I would recommend this product but please work on the packaging, there are other reviews where the stick flew out!
Really liked this product until the stick kept breaking and getting stuck in the lid.
This works well to cover my dark circles and it doesn't settle into my fine lines. So much more effective than concealer.

love the reflective properties that dilute dark circles. love the formula - cooling and easy to blend with a puff. i have oily-combo skin and i Have to set this almost immediately or it will crease (my fave iz about face curtain call!!). the only thing is this does not give me "skincare" results, would rather buy just a color correcter for cheaper tbh

love the reflective properties that dilute dark circles. love the formula - cooling and easy to blend with a puff. i have oily-combo skin and i Have to set this almost immediately or it will crease (my fave iz about face curtain call!!). the only thing is this does not give me "skincare" results, would rather buy just a color correcter for cheaper tbh

With the first twisting the cap and pulling open, the stick fell off and smashed the tip. It does have a smooth consistency, but it does not cover my dark circles well, although my dark circles are not that dark and I don't have skin bags under my eyes. Overall, it is overpriced for the quality and purpose.

I boight this a month ago. For the four months the packaging was working, I was very happy with it. Good color crrection for my datk circles, and nice smooth texture. But today I took off the cap(fnrtly, nit dramatically) and the entire stick came flying out and landed in the sink. Money wasted. Very frustrating.

This stick completely caught me off guard. Not onlybis is skincare but its the best color correction product i have used. It covers my dark circles kike nothing else!! I will buy this iver and over. My only minor critique is that is make some of my concealers crease, but its worth it because it covers so well that i dont need a ton of concealer anymore
Tjis looked ok when i first applied. Looked horrible after a fre hours under makeup. I looked super cakey and dry. Much worse than using nothing.

avis.titre: Stick broke after only a couple of uses
avis.texte: As others have noted, the product broke with minimal use; returned.
It covered my dark circles and made applying my concealer smooth! Totally Recommend
Didn't feel like it hid my dark circles. It wasn't thick enough.

This is my first experience using a color corrector (and I only bought it because it was on sale) and I have been impressed with the results. It blends really nicely and does an effective job with my dark circles. I would recommend and I will repurchase in the future.
60 year old here, settles in fine lines and makes eyes look dry and cakey
This stick is not very pigmented… it went on very sheer. I have very dark purple circles that need HELP! This did not help at all… I am returning it.

avis.titre: Buy NYX Pro Fix Stick instead
avis.texte: For a 1/4 of the price, NYX's concealer/correcting stick is more pigmented, blends better, and lasts longer. They also have 25 shades! Don't waste your money on this!

I have been using this for about 3 weeks. I use it in the morning after my eye cream. I feel like it helps with covering some of the darker areas under my eyes. I do not see much of a difference in the "bags" or swelling under my eyes, but they are covered with concealer.
Literally the worst…. Not sure how it even is in the category…. Its chalky, does not blend at all, pills and has to be wiped off. Tried because of 1/2 price sale….. dont bother with this! Its awful!
Went on easily. Felt creamy and not drying but unfortunately, it's settled into my fine lines and wrinkles. I think this would be a great product for younger gals!
Maybe I am using it wrong. It does not blend into my skin, ans shows EVERY dry patch. Just not for me.

avis.titre: Very hard/waxy and disappears when you blend in concealer
avis.texte: Try the NYX corrector stick instead. It has a smoother, more blendable texture, and is half the price! I love OLEHENRIKSEN, and have been loyal to the brand since 2017, but this is a skip for me!

I had very high hopes since I love other OleHenriksen items. But this just did not sit well in that delicate area, fell right into cracks and creases like concealer does. I thought it would be more smooth, slightly oily even for that glide but I probably cant incorporate this into my routine.

I don't wear makeup but have recently started wearing concealer to cover my bags. This works so much better than shape tape or the clinique corrector. One swipe and it blends in really easily. I was surprised that other reviews said it was dry or chalky. I feel like its almost on the oily side. I'd recommend this but probabl wouldnt pay full price for it.

I bought this product because it was new and they were offering 50% off. I've been looking for a color corrector that is sheer and not thick so it doesn't highlight under eye wrinkles. This corrector is perfect—nice and sheer with enough pigment to improve the under eye purple bags (a 5-month old and 3 year old will do that to you!). I wear it over my foundation and blend with the warmth of my fingers. You can layer on more without it caking.
I bought it as it was a beauty steal and was pleasantly surprised. It is a nice product. I liked it so much I got online and ordered another one!
Broke in half after 3 uses, and didn't really see any changes to my eyes

I went in to try a test product at ULTA before buying because I didn't want to buy then return. I used the color banana and wow. I had to buy. It got even better as I was driving back home and I checked how my under eyes looked in the mirror. Dark under eyes where?! Wondering if I should have bought 2 but it looks like a little goes a long way
This product in Guava just deposits a chalky pink under my eyes. Hard to blend because it's not creamy. The stick tugs my undereyes when I apply.

avis.titre: Seems to help a little but to the makeup consistency is hard
avis.texte: I bought this for under my eyes and find that its consistency is too hard. It needs to be creamier to apply it under your eyes.

This corrector stick in Banana was horrible. I fully understand this is skincare and not a concealer. I wasn't looking for any coverage as I know this is not for that purpose. I was looking for a hydrating eye balm with subtle correcting abilities to brighten the eyes. This stick was so drying under my eyes. I'm 47 with no wrinkles but dark hereditary circles. This faded within an hour of initial application. It provided no correcting at all. Also, it layers terribly under concealer and it cakes up and creases. I tossed it after one week of use.
I wasn't sure if I would like this but it has worked way better than an other under eye treatment I've used

avis.titre: only tried once and i already know
avis.texte: im definitely buying this again. this is now a staple. wowzer it works so good
Great as a color corrector or by uts self it has caffeine so its helping my eyebags and is such a nice consistency need to set lr anything i love it!!!!!

I am very disappointed in the poor quality of this item, especially for the price. The consistency of the stick is streaky and chunky. When I put the cap on, even if I rotate the stick downward, a chunk always comes off and leaves the top uneven. The entire mechanism inside broke and the stick fell out. Additionally, the product does not work well to brighten the undereye.

the item itself works nicely. when I first purchased it I opened it and the stick was completely broken and just slid out. it's like a lipstick tube. so I took it back and exchanged it. it happened again. I didn't want to take it back again so I just barely would twist it out so it qoukdnt fall out. fast forward to last week. the whole stick is now stuck in the top and I can't take it out. I used it maybe 3-4 times and now can't use it at all. unless I buy a small brush to stick into the cap. for the price I wouldn't buy this again. I'd rather it be in a pot to just get with my finger. very frustrating.

avis.titre: On my 3rd tube, it breaks easy though
avis.texte: I really love this product, the original banana color is great. Its easy to swipe on and it gives a brightening glow. I can wear it on no makeup days and even with my medium coverage foundation. There is no smell and it feels light on. The only thing that would keep me from continued purchase is that it breaks! Both of mine broke, near the end of the tube. This third one I ordered was completely broken off into the cap and part of it was broke and stuck into cap when I received it. Its very annoying. I dont feel like I can just whip it open and swipe it on because it breaks or falls out. This also wastes product and when you look at the amount of product in the tube, its not a lot.

WOW!! Tbis no make up girly is so happy ahe found this product. I can swipe a little of this under my eyes and i can see such a huge difference in my purple under eye circles. Not just that but i don't feel it and i don't feel like I'm wearing any makeup. Check check and check!

Got this on sale last week. I didnt realize that there was 4 shades. In my ulta i think we only had the banana shade instock so i bought that one. I wear it on top of an eye cream and since its summer i havent been wearing tons of makeup. I like that my eyes look brighter without having to wear actual concealor. I am more of a fair/light cool to neutral undertone and while the guava might have been better for me i think the banana atill works and i use it other places to cancel the red in my skin too. I definetely think i would repurchase

I have this eye stick in apricot. My complexion is tan with warm under tone. My under eyes are really dark and this product canels the blue/purple while also brightening. There is a shimmer to help reflect light and brighten the hollows or shadows under the eye. The shimmer almost undetectable and tolerable. It's sheer, but buildable. I only use this for no makeup days to look well rested. I have not used it under makeup. It might be too sheer and move around too much. It does settle into fine lines, so don't apply too much. I spray a brush with setting spray and apply it under my eyes and then apply the stick to only the blue/purple areas. It helps keep it in place. I will be buying this again. Be sure to see the product on you in natural light or outdoor lighting before deciding if it's a fit for you.
This ACTUALLY makes a difference!!! I love it!!! Takes away the I need more sleep look!!
It's very buttery smooth going on. I like the texture but it's a tad too dark on my fair skin. I got guava and wish it was lighter. Overall I will keep it but not sure I'm going to rebuy.

Ive tried this for 6 months before leaving a review. This really works and people have complimented me on the results. Get rid of dark circles and makes the skin under the eye appear tighter and firm. Also gets rid of puffiness.

I buy this every month when i run out to hide my dark circles because im lazy to put on makeup i do love it but it does leave creases on the eye smile lines sadly to fix it you have to touch up or pat under your eye to smooth it out

avis.titre: The best thing for under eyes
avis.texte: I bought this product on a whim bc I was so sick of spending crazy money on high end concealers and setting powders only for them to STILL CREASE. Im also not a fan of a full face of makeup look — I hate when you get close and you can see every drop of makeup. This was my first experience with a "corrector," and I was shook. It does NOT crease for me and I have not been using setting powder. The coverage lasts all day and never looks cakey. Its light enough to wear on no makeup days and it truly does reflect and manipulate light in a way to dull the appearance. I dont think ill ever go back to normal concealer and powder combination. This single product handled my dark circles with ease while also doing away w the hassle of creasing and cakiness. Full disclosure — I did try to layer this under concealer and had major caking and creasing. That combo didnt work for me.
This little stick (banana) covers dark circles pretty well. Not COMPLETELY but does help a lot in covering severe dark circles!

avis.titre: Wanted to love it, but can't.
avis.texte: Bought this thinking it would be something easy to put on and help conceal dark circles. Did a patch test on my hand and had no issues. but I put it under my eyes yesterday and had a pretty terrible allergic reaction. Swollen, itchy, dry. I'm going to have to baby my under eyes for at least the next week. Very sad and disappointing. Will be returning.
Unfortunately I was unable to use it long enough to see a difference as it inflamed my under eyelids. They were swollen, red and painful. So I would not be able to recommend.

When i opened my package my item was damaged a but i was so disappointed. It looks as if the cap touched the top. Its not too bad but this why i order online instead of in store pick up because i dont like my stuff being opened. So i dont underatand what happened if it came from the warehouse. I used the part where its not touched & i really like it so far but i am returning & getting a new untouched one!
I got it in shade Banana and its a bit yellow for me but a little concealer overtop of it does wonders. Hides the dark circles really well. Creases just a little though.

This product is greasy and does not blend well with other profucts. When put on first, any product on top of it gets tainted by how greasy it is and does not stay true to its normal color or consistency. There were even patches that stayed thicker than others never blending.
This is amazing ... super moisturizing no creasing ... use it alone or with concealer Best purchase ever!
I bought this from a location quite far from my house. As soon as I opened the cap, the concealer literally fell out. The entire stick literally fell out. It was obviously used.

avis.titre: Buy and Try Product for Yourself!
avis.texte: Great product to use and have! I have tried so many products for covering up Dark Undereye Circles and with this one I did see Great Results!

I've been using this product for a month and love it! I use it as the last step of my skin care as an under eye prep before I start applying my make up. It helps color correct the under eye and makes concealer look flawless. Keep in mind this is not a straight up makeup product, it is a skincare product that is pigmented. If you're looking for a pure, full coverage color corrector, this may not be it. This product helps hydrate the skin, preps for makeup and does some evening out of uneven tone and darkness. I've really liked it in my routine and would recommend it to anyone with some undeye darkness.

I really like this product! I use it as a concealer and contour when doing my full face makeup or just as a undereye brightner with skincare only. The texture is really smooth and creamy but it's not greasy. It blends well with other products and it has good coverage. It doesn't give me problems with setting or baking. You can also use it alone or with a BB cream. I have the banana color and its the perfect brightness. No heavy feeling or stickiness or creasing. Only problem is the product kind of slips out of the applicator but i just keep it in by not twisting it out too far. Overall very happy with my purchase!
These brightening sticks are amazing! The are creamy, dont settle into my lines and reallt brighten up and color correct the areas i use it. I reach for ar least one daily

I am light-medium skin toned and have tge shade banana. I really enjoy it! I put it under my eyes, blend with my finger, and tgen add my concealer on top. Blends reallt good and lays under concealer really well.

avis.titre: Great for no makeup makeup days
avis.texte: It's amazing layered under concealer for color correction, but mostly I wear this on its own for a bit of coverage and brightening under my eyes. It's really quick and easy to use, super creamy, blends well with a finger AND has skincare benefits.
I use this every day under my makeup! Love it. Can be used with or without makeup.
I have very dark circles so it doesn't cover them completely, but it reduces them their intensity. it almost completely covers my dark spots.
Vitamin eye stick is terrible. don' waste your money on this product it doesn' work
They cover my blue veins under my eyes. I will be ordering more.

avis.titre: I didn't know this came in different hues
avis.texte: It would have been nice to know this comes in different hues. I got one for white skin and I'm a brown woman.
Easy to apply and adds a really nice brightening effect! Color match was perfect but the shade range is unfortunately limited.

I use this product with the banana brightening cream. I usually use the cream first and then I put the stick on about 15 to 20 minutes later. And I have noticed that my skin is brighter under my eyes, and sometimes I don't even use concealer
Feels great and lightweight. You will still need a concealer, as it does not hide any black under-eye bags. But it's a nice base.
Beautiful coverage with natural glow. So easy for daily use I love it
I have really dark undereye circles. I don't use with concealer it I just use it on its own. Doesn't completely cover darkness on its own, but depuffs and gives me that well rested glow.
It arrived twisted up and smashed into the lid. I'm still using it (by scraping it out with a makeup brush) because this cost $$$. Probably will not purchase again unless they improve the packaging.

I have been trying to find something to help my bags not look so dark. I am new to finding things but have been reading alot before I splurge as I don't have alot of money. So far, this is a pretty solid product that has helped when I do what to use a concealer. And it did last longer than other products.
I wanted this to work on my dark circles! But the texture isn' right: it's too thick, a bit too dry, and just too darn yellow. I should have known better.
I like the colour it looks a little brighter under my eye but when I try to gently even it out it feels too dry and I have to apply the Banana Bright+Eye Cream.
Love this product it is so easy to use and as always the quality is superb!
Fabulous product!! Honestly works like a concealer for me, with all the benefits!!
It's okay. A bit hydrating but it doesn't cover too much dark circles.

I love this! It's fair enough that I can use it as a concealer. I would love if they came out when a more neutral color for concealer or to cover ups spots for that makeup look that's actually skin care!
Nice lite concealer, buildsble. Feels heavenly under and around eyes and does cause puffiness. Ordered the light color
It was so hard to open it and when I opened it, the stick inside broken and not able to use it.

avis.titre: Awesome for a natural looking look
avis.texte: This product, along with the Sun-Kissed Banana Bright is an essential duo for makeup free days!
Dry and chunky. Ridiculously hard to apply. I know how to apply makeup after spending years on television. Would NEVER purchase this again.
The banana bright I ordered is not dark enough for dark under eye cirlces
It didn' blow me away. No coverage . Nothing. It didn' brighten. Thumbs down :thumbsdown:
Not sure what is in your products but I had an allergic reaction and my face looked awful for over a week
